data.name: ConsoleHelp
data.value:
Usage: ftps-server [options] ftps-server --config <path-to-json>
Options:
--help Show this help.
--config <path> JSON configuration file.
--ip <address> IP address to listen on. Default: 0.0.0.0. 0.0.0.0, ::, and ::0 listen on every IPv4 and IPv6 interface.
--port <number> Port to listen on. Default: 2121. Allowed: 2121-65535.
--maxconnections <number> Maximum simultaneous connections. Default: 10. Allowed: 2-100.
--cert <path> Certificate file (.pfx, .pem, or .der). A .pfx file is opened with --certpass when a password is set.
--certpass <password> Password for the certificate file.
--certstorename <name> Store name: AuthRoot, CertificateAuthority, My, Root, or TrustedPublisher. Set together with --certstorelocation and --certstoresubject.
--certstorelocation <location> Store location: CurrentUser or LocalMachine. Set together with --certstorename and --certstoresubject.
--certstoresubject <subject> Subject name to find in the certificate store. Set together with --certstorename and --certstorelocation.
--user <login#password#folder#permissions> Add a user. Permissions: R (read), W (write), or RW. The folder must already exist. Do not use # inside the four fields. Example: --user "admin#secret#C:\ftp\admin#RW"
Examples: ftps-server --config settings.json ftps-server --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 2121 --user "admin#secret#C:\ftp\admin#RW" ftps-server --cert server.pfx --certpass secret
With no arguments, appsettings.json in the current directory is loaded when that file exists. When no users are configured, interactive setup starts.
